jobs.description:
Our client is a leading industrial manufacturing organisation operating within a highly technical and project-driven production environment.

Jobomschrijving

• Assess the manufacturability and technical feasibility of customer-approved designs, identifying risks, constraints, and optimisation opportunities.
• Create and maintain production documentation including technical drawings, CAD models, work instructions, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and ERP master data.
• Provide technical support to production teams, troubleshoot manufacturing issues, and contribute to root cause analyses and corrective actions.
• Optimise designs, materials, and production processes to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance manufacturing performance.
• Collaborate closely with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Product Management, and Engineering teams to ensure technical alignment and operational excellence.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Materials Engineering, Design Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, technical design, or a similar production-focused role.
• Strong proficiency with CAD software (such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Inventor) and experience managing BOMs, routings, and technical master data in ERP systems (SAP, Dynamics, or similar).
• Solid understanding of manufacturing processes, design for manufacturability principles, technical problem solving, and cost estimation within an industrial environment.
• Analytical, detail-oriented, and hands-on professional with strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple departments.
• Fluent in English and Dutch

Our client is a leading player within the commercial real estate sector in Belgium. Active on high-profile projects across Brussels and other major cities, our client supports businesses, investors, and property owners with innovative real estate solutions and strategic advisory services.

Description

As an Account Manager - Real Estate, your responsibilities will include:

 

• Managing and developing a portfolio of existing clients within the real estate sector.
• Identifying and pursuing new business opportunities through networking, prospecting, and market engagement.
• Advising clients on tailored real estate solutions aligned with their business and investment objectives.
• Leading commercial discussions, preparing proposals, and negotiating contracts.
• Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders to ensure exceptional service delivery and long-term client satisfaction.
 

The successful Account Manager - Real Estate should have:

 

• 2 to 5 years of experience in Account Management, Business Development, Sales, or a related commercial role.
• Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to engage with senior-level decision-makers.
• A proactive commercial mindset with a passion for developing business opportunities.
• Fluency in French and Dutch; English is considered a strong asset.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and organisational skills.

• Installing, commissioning and fine-tuning equipment at customer sites both nationally and internationally.
• Analysing technical issues and proposing improvements to products and processes.
• Preparing technical documentation, manuals and work instructions.
• Collaborating closely with colleagues from engineering, production and service departments.
• Providing technical support during demonstrations, trade fairs and commercial activities.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you have:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electromechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Machine Building or a related technical field.
• A strong interest in machine building, automation and product development.
• A hands-on mentality and practical approach to engineering.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
